add_grocery_item.name: add_grocery_item
add_grocery_item.description: Puts a thing to buy on the grocery list. What is left at home is update_stock, a product's catalogue data manage_products or manage_ingredients, an item listed again on its own manage_recurring_groceries. Adds an item by label. A matching product's preferred store is assigned, else storeId or storeName. A product already on the list (not ticked) accumulates on its line, even in another unit. quantity with unit, or packagings (whole number >= 1, packaged products only), never both. A packaged product is counted in packagings, rounded up (asked quantity kept in desiredQuantity); with neither: restockQuantity, else the 7-day meal need, else 1. Returns productId, recipeNeed (base units, null when none), coversWeek, packagingsToCover.

answer_task_reminder.name: answer_task_reminder
answer_task_reminder.description: For the owner's answer to a task reminder he received; a task changed outside such an answer is update_task, an approval card answer_approval. Answers a task reminder, as the notification button would. reminderId comes with the user's message. Actions: done (ticks the task), in10 (reminder in ten minutes), tonight (after dinner), tomorrow (into tomorrow's five), start (begins it now), open. A reminder is answered once and not every kind accepts every action: a refusal says why.

assign_product_store.name: assign_product_store
assign_product_store.description: productId: the one add_grocery_item returns, not the list item id. Sets a product's preferredStoreId, fallbackStoreId, shelfLifeDays (null: non-perishable) and aisle: id or name (an unknown name creates it, see manage_aisles; empty string: none). The aisle applies to aisleStoreId, else the preferred store.

cancel_proaction.name: cancel_proaction
cancel_proaction.description: Cancels a run of Maggie only; a task, an event or a directive goes with its own tool (delete_task, delete_event, delete_instruction). Cancels a proaction by its id (from list_proactions): it is removed from the « Maggie » agenda and will not run. The id of a series (rrule in list_proactions) without occurrence deletes the series: no run is left, the ones already done stay. With occurrence (ISO 8601, as listed in occurrences) it cancels that occurrence only.

check_conflicts.name: check_conflicts
check_conflicts.description: Call it before create_event, or before update_event moves a timed event. Returns the timed events overlapping the slot; any means the slot is taken. Periods, whole-day events and proactions never conflict. Slot: a given date (YYYY-MM-DD), time (HH:MM) and duration in minutes (default 60).

check_grocery_item.name: check_grocery_item
check_grocery_item.description: Sets the checked state of an item: checked=true when bought, false to uncheck. Item id from get_grocery_list. Ticking neither ends the errand nor changes stock: end_errand does both.

check_routine.name: check_routine
check_routine.description: Ticks a routine as done on a day, or removes the tick (done=false). id is from list_routines. date is YYYY-MM-DD, today in the user's timezone by default; a future day or one before the routine existed is refused. Repeating a tick or removing an absent one changes nothing. Returns {success, date, checked, routine}. A task is ticked with update_task.

choose_workout_makeup.name: choose_workout_makeup
choose_workout_makeup.description: Only for a missed-session proposal the owner answers; another session is manage_workouts. Plans the make-up chosen for a missed-session proposal. makeup_id: proposal id or IRI. option: softer (same session tonight, next quarter hour), shorter (shorter one tonight), tomorrow (same session tomorrow); softer and shorter only while offered (day of the miss, until 23:00). Creates a planned workout: {success, makeup, workout}. A proposal answers once: already chosen, obsolete or option too late → {error, status}.

claim_due_proactions.name: claim_due_proactions
claim_due_proactions.description: Atomically claims the pending proactions whose time has come (or the one given by id, due or not) and marks them running, each returned with its userId, prompt, kind and origin (null when unknown); a check also carries signaledTopics, the topics delivered to its user these last 7 days ({topic, at, delivery, notice}) and checkedValues, the last value verified per topic these last 40 days ({topic, value, at}). A due occurrence of a series is returned as its own proaction, with seriesId and occurrence; the series itself is never claimed. Executor only, never offered to the model.

create_event.name: create_event

reminders.description: minutes before the start, e.g. [60] for "une heure avant"

create_event.description: An event is an appointment or a dated activity on one of the owner's agendas, possibly inside a period; what fills the whole time and makes him unavailable is an event even over several days. A context during which other things happen and get planned (a trip, holidays, custody, a stay away) is a period (manage_periods), never a long event; a planned meal is a meal (manage_meals); a thing he has to do is a task (create_task). Before a timed event, call check_conflicts on its slot; a conflict: create nothing, tell him and ask. A period over the slot is no conflict. Give a start and an end, never a duration: start_date (YYYY-MM-DD) + start_time (HH:MM) + end_date + end_time, or all_day true + start_date + end_date; end_date is EXCLUDED (1 January alone: 2037-01-01 to 2037-01-02). An incomplete schedule or an end not after the start creates nothing and returns an error. agenda_id: agenda name or id; omitted, inferred. Two equally plausible agendas, or a name matching none: error naming them, nothing created. reminders: minutes before start, e.g. [10, 1440]. rrule: RFC 5545 without the RRULE: prefix, e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO; status: tentative or confirmed. Returns the saved event in its own time zone: allDay; startAt, endAt (timed); startDate, endDate, lastDay (whole-day); agenda; status; weekday, startWeekday, endWeekday, lastDayWeekday for each local date.

create_recipe.name: create_recipe
create_recipe.description: A recipe is how to cook a dish; planning it on a day is a meal (manage_meals). Before: search_recipes, an existing recipe is updated, not created again. Create a recipe; with no ingredients and no steps it is refused, the error saying what is missing. ingredients: JSON array of {quantity, unit, ingredientId or ciqualAlimCode (creates the Ingredient from that Ciqual food), pieceWeightGrams?}; nutrition counts only ingredients with Ciqual values, and piece lines with pieceWeightGrams. steps: JSON array in order of {text, durationMinutes?, background? (timer runs while the cook moves on), ingredientIds? (recipe ids or names), utensils?, waitsFor? (earlier step positions)}. utensils: JSON array of ids or names; unknown names are added. tags: comma-separated.

create_task.name: create_task
create_task.description: A task is something the owner has to do, once or again and again; what Maggie herself must do or say at a time is a proaction (schedule_proaction), a standing preference a directive (add_instruction). What comes back is one task with rrule, never one per date. A list of things goes in description as Markdown boxes, never as subtasks. dueDate is the limit, scheduledDate the day he plans to do it; a time is promised only with scheduledTime. timed only when the duration is the task. Its card shows under the answer: copy nothing of it. Creates a task. priority: low, medium, high. criticality: low, medium, high, critical. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. parentId: a top-level task. estimatedMinutes 1-1440; firstStep. dueDate: deadline; scheduledDate: planned day. scheduledMoment: morning/afternoon/evening, or time with scheduledTime HH:MM; reminders (time only): minutes before, 0 at it. timed=true: timer. rrule (RFC 5545, no "RRULE:", DAILY-YEARLY, UNTIL not COUNT) repeats from scheduledDate, else dueDate, a day of the rule; done or past, the next task takes it.

delete_event.name: delete_event
delete_event.description: Deletes an event of the owner's agendas (id from get_events); a period goes with manage_periods, a run of Maggie with cancel_proaction, a task with delete_task. Delete a calendar event by its ID. Returns confirmation of deletion. A recurring series is designated by its master event's id; deleting it removes every occurrence.

delete_recipe.name: delete_recipe
delete_recipe.description: Deletes it for good; taking it off one meal is manage_meals update. Delete a recipe by id. Meals with no other recipe are deleted with it (their shopping leaves the grocery list); other meals keep their recipes. Returns deletedMeals.

delete_task.name: delete_task
delete_task.description: Deletes one of the owner's tasks by its id (from get_tasks) for good; a task done is update_task done=true, a routine paused save_routine active=false. Returns a confirmation.

end_errand.name: end_errand
end_errand.description: Ends a shopping trip once the owner is done. Archives checked items as past errands, one per store (errands: id, storeName, itemCount), removes them from the list, puts their products In Stock (restockedProducts), returns the unchecked items. storeId ends that store only; paidAmountCents (whole cents, needs storeId) records what was paid.

estimate_trip.name: estimate_trip
estimate_trip.description: Estimates, keeps nothing; the trip kept for the departure alert is set_trip. Estimate the trip to an event, several modes at once. date (YYYY-MM-DD, Paris): the occurrence's day; required for a repeating event, else optional and must match. modes: drive, transit, walk, bicycle. origin: position (phone's last position, default), home (the user's home), place:<id> or event:<id>. leg: outbound (default) or return (event place to home, origin ignored, departAt required, ISO 8601 Paris time). arriveAt (ISO 8601 Paris time): required for a whole-day event, refused otherwise; departAt counts back from it. carAt (drive only): parked (where the phone last saw the car parked, refused if never seen) or origin (at the trip's origin, no walk to it); default: parked from position, origin from home or place:<id>, from event:<id> at that event when reached by car. Returns {eventId, estimates: [{leg, mode, origin: {kind, id, label, latitude, longitude, capturedAt?}, steps: [{kind, minutes, label?}], durationMinutes, departAt, navigationUrl, parkingKnown, carLatitude?, carLongitude?}], unavailable: [{mode, reason}], locationRequested}. unavailable: modes with no route. locationRequested: position older than 10 min, used anyway. Refused: {error, field}; {error} alone if no route or Google unavailable.

generate_grocery_list.name: generate_grocery_list
generate_grocery_list.description: Top up the grocery list with recurring items due again (idempotent). Meals add nothing: mealsToChoose lists meals in the date range (YYYY-MM-DD) whose ingredients are not chosen (id, date, slot, summary), to choose with manage_meal_groceries. A one-off item is add_grocery_item.

get_activity_status.name: get_activity_status
get_activity_status.description: An activity is a guided flow the owner left in progress. Reads the status of an activity left in progress. activity is cuisine, comptes or bilan (the evening review: step, answers, instructions). Returns {activity, origin, state, startedAt, updatedAt}, or null when nothing is in progress. Read-only.

get_daily_balance.name: get_daily_balance
get_daily_balance.description: Read-only; an intake is written with manage_food_intakes. Reads one day's calorie balance, date YYYY-MM-DD. Returns {date, eatenKcal, plannedKcal (planned meals not yet eaten), expendedKcal (get_daily_energy), balanceKcal = eaten + planned - expended, proteinG, carbsG, fatG, plannedMeals: [{mealId, slot, label, kcal, proteinG, carbsG, fatG}]}. expendedKcal, balanceKcal are null while the profile is incomplete.

get_daily_energy.name: get_daily_energy
get_daily_energy.description: Read-only. Reads energy expenditure per day, from and to included (YYYY-MM-DD, max 400 days). Returns {days}: per local day {date, steps, activeKcal (Health Connect), bmrKcal, workoutKcal, stepsKcal (activeKcal minus sessions Health Connect counted), expendedKcal = bmrKcal + activeKcal + sessions Health Connect did not see}. Null without data; bmrKcal and expendedKcal null while the profile is incomplete.

get_day_context.name: get_day_context
get_day_context.description: Reads the periods covering a day, so Maggie adapts to that context; events are get_events, tasks get_tasks. Read-only: periods are written with manage_periods. Describes a day as {date, weekend, periods: [{id, name, agenda: {id, name}, allDay, start, end}]}. date is YYYY-MM-DD, today by default, read in Paris. periods are all those covering the day (custody, holidays, a trip…); start and end are the occurrence bounds, instants or days with the end day included.

get_day_plan.name: get_day_plan
get_day_plan.description: The day plan is the ordered short list of tasks chosen for a day, with its reserve; it holds no event (get_events), and every task stays readable with get_tasks. Reads the day: at most 5 slots. date YYYY-MM-DD, today by default. Returns slots [{position, type, task}], now (first slot not done, or null), reserve (other open non-subtasks by orderScore), done, total, confirmedAt (null while proposed). A task has id, title, estimatedMinutes, firstStep, completedAt, dueDate, scheduledDate, postponedSince, urgency, criticality, rrule.

get_event.name: get_event
get_event.description: One event whose id a result gave; events by day or by name are get_events. Get one calendar event by its ID: summary, start, end, all-day flag and agenda. Works for past events too. A whole-day event (allDay true) has no startAt/endAt but startDate, endDate (EXCLUDED, as in Google's API: the day after its last day) and lastDay. Every local date comes with its day of the week (startWeekday, endWeekday for a timed event; startWeekday and lastDayWeekday for a whole-day one).

get_events.name: get_events

agendas.description: names or ids of the agendas to read

get_events.description: The only source for the dates and times of the owner's events: read it in the turn, never from memory or history. Gets events from all agendas, recurring events expanded: one day, a range, or a search by name. A named event: query without to, all agendas; agendas only when the owner limits them in that message or a saved directive does, never for a search by name. A dictated name with no result: retry a variant before asking. Follow hint. A planned meal is not an event: manage_meals. from: first day (YYYY-MM-DD), default now. to: last day, included; default from + 6 days (from + 365 days with query). At most 31 days without query, 366 with. query: word(s) of a title or place; a recurring series comes back once, as master (id, rrule, first occurrence of the window in startAt). agendas: names (case and accents ignored) or ids; a name matching no agenda returns an error listing the agendas. Omit to read all. A whole-day event (allDay true) has startDate, endDate (EXCLUDED: the day after its last day) and lastDay, no startAt/endAt. Local dates come with their weekday (startWeekday, endWeekday; whole-day: startWeekday, lastDayWeekday). Each event has agenda (name) and timeZone. Returns {from, to, events, count}.

get_exercises.name: get_exercises
get_exercises.description: The slugs manage_workouts and get_next_prescription take. Reads the exercise catalogue. Optional: pattern (vertical_pull, horizontal_pull, vertical_push, horizontal_push, squat, hinge, lunge, core_anterior, core_lateral), equipment (list of pull_up_bar, weighted_bag, chair, table, band, parallel_bars, wall; empty = bodyweight only), slug. Returns {exercises}: {slug, name, pattern, primaryMuscles, secondaryMuscles, kind, equipment, nervousCost, eccentric, unit (reps, seconds, meters), perSide, loadable, ladders}. Unknown value: {error}.

get_fasting.name: get_fasting
get_fasting.description: Read-only; the protocol is set with update_health_profile. Reads one day's intermittent fast, date YYYY-MM-DD, derived from the food journal. Returns {date, protocol (14:10, 16:8, 18:6, 20:4; null if none), windowStart, windowEnd (HH:MM), openedAt (first intake), lastIntakeAt, state (fasting: nothing eaten yet; open: until windowEnd; closed), nightFastMinutes (previous day's last intake to this day's first)}. A future day gives its window only.

get_finance_projection.name: get_finance_projection
get_finance_projection.description: What comes in the next months; what happened is get_finance_summary. Projects what comes, from entered data only (nothing is extrapolated). months: 1 to 12 (default: to the end of the month after the expected salary). Integer cents. salary {isConfigured, expectedOn, referenceCents, isLate, delayDays, shortfallCents}, balanceCents (checking today), projection[] day by day, overdraft {isForecast, onDate, worstBalanceCents, limitCents}, outstandingAdvancesCents; nextWeek and nextMonth: the week and month after this one with incomeCents, expenseCents, netCents and their lines. Moves no money.

get_finance_summary.name: get_finance_summary
get_finance_summary.description: What happened over a past or current period, read-only; what comes is get_finance_projection, a what-if over years manage_scenarios. Reads the financial state of a period (period: YYYY-MM, default current month, or YYYY). spending: every debit against what was planned, with the daily curve. envelopes: consumed vs budgeted. satisfaction: worth keeping vs avoidable. savings: put aside vs planned capacity. cushion. toQualify: unqualified lines. scores: week, month and global colours with their reasons (null for a year). salary: reference monthly salary, its source (declared, expected, measured, unknown) and the delay. advances: money taken from savings, outstanding per source. independence: how far the rentes cover the lifestyle. Integer cents.

get_grocery_list.name: get_grocery_list
get_grocery_list.description: What is still to buy. What was bought is list_past_errands, what is at home update_stock, what may be due again get_purchase_suggestions. Read it before changing an item. The list by store in visit order, then aisle (aisle {id, name, position}, null last), then position. Items with buyAfter in the future are in later; includeDeferred=true moves them into the store groups. One line per product: needed (base units), quantity and unit to buy (whole packagings for a packaged product), desiredQuantity, desiredUnit, packaging (null when none), stockState.

get_health_day.name: get_health_day
get_health_day.description: The day's journal; calorie detail is get_daily_balance, energy get_daily_energy. Reads one local day of the health journal, date YYYY-MM-DD. Returns {day: {id, date, weightKg, bodyFatPercent, weighedAt (first weighing of the day not set aside), steps, eatenKcal, expendedKcal, balanceKcal (eaten - expended; today live, planned meals included), sportMinutes, mood, fatigue (1-10), note, notedBy (user, maggie), notedAt}}. Null when nothing is recorded.

get_health_profile.name: get_health_profile
get_health_profile.description: The owner's stable health data. Reads the health profile. Returns {id (null if never written), sex, birthYear, age, heightCm, weightKg (latest weighing not set aside), activityLevel (sedentary x1.2 to very_active x1.9), mode (computed, entered), bmrKcal, needKcal, factor (need / bmr), stepGoal, suggestionWindowStart, suggestionWindowEnd, sessionMinutes, stepSource}. bmrKcal, needKcal null while sex, age, height or weight is missing.

get_my_location.name: get_my_location
get_my_location.description: Where the phone last was; saved places are list_places. Reads the user's phone last GPS position. Returns {position}: {latitude, longitude, accuracy (metres), capturedAt, ageMinutes}, or null when the phone never reported a GPS point (the position must be allowed in the app). Only GPS positions are stored, and the last one stays the position whatever its age.

get_next_prescription.name: get_next_prescription
get_next_prescription.description: Computes, writes nothing. Returns the next prescription for one exercise from the coded progression rules. exercise: catalogue slug; variant: normal (default), soft (one set less, 3 reps in reserve), deload (half the sets, 3 reps in reserve). Returns {prescription, reason, basedOn}: prescription = an exercise line for manage_workouts (its exercise may differ from the one asked); reason = the rule applied; basedOn = ids of the sessions read. Unknown slug or variant: {error}.

get_purchase_suggestions.name: get_purchase_suggestions
get_purchase_suggestions.description: Suggestions only, nothing is listed: add_grocery_item once the owner wants one. Products bought 3+ times in past errands and due again: everyDays (median gap), lastBoughtOn, dueOn (YYYY-MM-DD), usualQuantity, usualUnit (null when unknown). Products already listed, recurring or dismissed are left out.

get_recipe.name: get_recipe
get_recipe.description: Get a recipe by id with ingredients, utensils and steps (text, durationMinutes, background, ingredients, utensils, waitsFor = positions awaited). guests (1 or more) scales quantities (x guests / servings) without changing the recipe; the answer carries scaledFor and scaleFactor. Id from search_recipes.

get_seasonal_produce.name: get_seasonal_produce
get_seasonal_produce.description: Fruits and vegetables in season in metropolitan France for month (1-12, default: current), and the user's own products in season (season set by manage_products seasonMonths). Reference data, read-only.

get_tasks.name: get_tasks
get_tasks.description: A task is something the owner has to do. His day is get_events of the day plus get_tasks day, presented in the order returned. dated false: the tasks with no day; on a light day (few events, no high or critical task) propose the first, and set its dueDate only after his yes. Gets tasks, filters combined with AND. status: pending (default), done, all. day (YYYY-MM-DD): planned that day, or planned or due that day or before and not done. dueFrom/dueTo, scheduledFrom/scheduledTo: inclusive bounds. dated: false = no due nor planned day, true = one of them. parentId: the subtasks of a task. limit: 50, at most 200. Highest orderScore first; done: most recently done first. Returns {tasks, count, total}; a task has urgency (low, normal, high, critical), orderScore and overdueDays (null if not late).

get_training_status.name: get_training_status
get_training_status.description: Read-only. Reads the strength program status, date YYYY-MM-DD. Returns {date, programWeek (from the first done calibration session), phase (calibration weeks 1-2, ramp_up 3-4, normal), deload {due, reason (scheduled, stagnation, hard_sessions, null), weeksSinceLast}, stagnating (slugs without gain for over 14 days), week {planned, done}, hardSetsByPattern}. Invalid date: {error}.

get_user_timezone.name: get_user_timezone
get_user_timezone.description: The owner's own zone and working hours. Reads the IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Paris) the user chose in their preferences, and their working hours (HH:MM start and end, ISO days 1 = Monday … 7).

get_weather.name: get_weather
get_weather.description: Daily forecast from Open-Meteo: condition (text, `condition_code`: clear, partly_cloudy, cloudy, fog, drizzle, rain, showers, snow, storm), min/max temperature (°C), rain (mm, probability), wind and gusts (km/h), alerts. Without `date`: today and tomorrow; with `date` (YYYY-MM-DD, up to 15 days ahead): that day. `location`: city, default the user's. Failure returns `error`. Read-only.

import_bank_transactions.name: import_bank_transactions
import_bank_transactions.description: Only the movements the owner chose, read first with read_bank_statement; never a whole history unasked. Imports chosen bank movements into Maggie. accountId, from, to: as given to read_bank_statement (the bank is read again); refs[]: ref values of chosen entries, 200 at most. Movements already in Maggie are skipped, so a rerun imports nothing. Returns {imported, skipped, unknownRefs (absent from the bank's answer), transactionIds}; or status history_unavailable / rate_limited with the bank's message, nothing imported. Error: refs empty or above 200. Imported movements have no category, like the regular sync (qualify with manage_transactions, manage_peer_debts for a transfer with a person).

list_daily_rendezvous.name: list_daily_rendezvous
list_daily_rendezvous.description: Lists each user's daily rendezvous settings (morning digest, evening review: on or off, HH:MM hour). Executor only, never offered to the model.

list_past_errands.name: list_past_errands
list_past_errands.description: What was bought, errand by errand; the current list is get_grocery_list. Past errands, most recent first: one store each (storeName, null when none), endedAt (ISO 8601), items (label, quantity, unit, product IRI or null, packaging fields). store matches the name in part, case-insensitively; limit 1-20 (default 5).

list_places.name: list_places
list_places.description: A place is an address the owner keeps; where the phone is now is get_my_location. Reads the user's places, home (« Maison ») first then by name, as {places: [...]}. A place has id, name, address, latitude and longitude (null until the address is located), parkingAddress, parkingLatitude and parkingLongitude (null when none), and isHome. When there is no home, the address of the owner's Google account is imported as « Maison » if it has one.

list_proactions.name: list_proactions
list_proactions.description: A proaction is a run of Maggie herself at a set time (a reminder she gives, a check she makes); the owner's to-dos are tasks (get_tasks), his appointments events (get_events). Lists the proactions scheduled for the user, by time, in three keys: proactions (one-off runs and the occurrences of a series that have their own run), series (the repeating ones, with their rrule) and, only when from and to are both given, occurrences (the coming runs of the series in the window with no run of their own yet: seriesId, occurrence, scheduledAt, prompt, summary, kind). Each proaction has its prompt, scheduledAt and status (pending, running, completed with its response, failed with its error). from and to (ISO 8601, or YYYY-MM-DD for a whole day, read in Europe/Paris) bound scheduledAt; status filters proactions only.

list_routines.name: list_routines
list_routines.description: A routine is a habit kept at a moment of the day and ticked each day it is due, with totals, never a streak; a thing to do, even one that comes back, is a task (get_tasks). Reads routines. Without date: all, as {routines}. With date (YYYY-MM-DD): active routines due that day, as {date, moments: [{anchor, time, routines}]}. A routine has id, title, anchor (wake, afterBreakfast, afterLunch, afterDinner, time), anchorTime HH:MM, time, recurrence ({kind, weekday, monthDay}), active, remind, createdAt, checkedToday, dueToday, monthCount, totalCount.

list_trips.name: list_trips
list_trips.description: Read the trips kept with set_trip that leave on a day (date, YYYY-MM-DD, read in Paris), by departure time, as {date, trips: [...]}, each as set_trip returns it, with originDecidedBy (user or maggie). Read-only; a trip is changed with set_trip.

manage_accounts.name: manage_accounts
manage_accounts.description: An account is where money sits; a movement on it is a transaction (manage_transactions), a bank credit manage_loans. List, create, update, delete or link bank accounts: name, bank, type (checking, savings, investment, cash), currency (ISO 4217), balance in integer cents, optional cushion flag (emergency fund). On update only provided fields change; list bank in clear to empty it. link folds the bank-created account (bankAccountId, absorbed) into the hand-typed one (accountId, kept): the kept account keeps its name, type, cushion flag and references and takes the bank connection, identification and balance; the absorbed one's movements move onto it (twins dropped after their category is carried over), then it is deleted. Without confirm nothing is written: it returns the preview (kept, moved, dropped); confirm true applies it. Refused when the kept account is already bank-linked, the other is not, the currencies differ, or an account is not the user's.

manage_agendas.name: manage_agendas
manage_agendas.description: An agenda holds events and periods (one per person or domain), with its time zone; it is never an event itself. Lists, creates, updates or deletes agendas. An agenda has a name, description, IANA time zone, colour and a default flag. On update, an optional field is emptied by listing its name in clear (description, color). A Google-connected agenda is renamed in Google too: if Google refuses the name, the update fails with an error and the agenda keeps its name.

manage_aisles.name: manage_aisles
manage_aisles.description: An aisle is a section of one store, in walking order; storeId from manage_stores. Actions: list, create, update (rename and/or move), reorder, delete the aisles of a store (position 1 first). list, create, reorder need storeId; update, delete need aisleId. create is last unless position is given. reorder takes aisleIds (all of the store). Deleting leaves its products without an aisle there.

manage_body_measurements.name: manage_body_measurements
manage_body_measurements.description: A measurement is one weighing or body measure at an instant. Actions: list, create, update, delete, exclude. Fields: measuredAt (ISO 8601 with offset, default now), weightKg (max 500), bodyFatPercent (<100), waistCm (max 300), all >0, at least one on create; source (manual default, health_connect, withings), externalId, excluded (kept, not counted). update, delete, exclude need measurementId; update changes only fields given. list: after, before, limit (max 366). Returns {measurements} or {success, measurement}. Refusal changes nothing: {error, field?, current?}.

manage_categories.name: manage_categories
manage_categories.description: A category classifies movements; the amount allowed to one over a period is an envelope (manage_envelopes). List, create, update or delete budget categories. A tree of at most three levels (parentId; a level-3 category has no children, none moves under its own descendants or past level 3). Read with depth (1-3) and path (names joined by « › »). obligation (deprecated, only the default qualification of a new transaction line): mandatory, optional, saving, investment, debt or income. passiveIncome flags an income category whose money comes in without work (rent, dividends, interest, royalties): the independence counter counts it; refused on any other category. On update only provided fields change; list parentId, color or icon in clear to empty them.

manage_contacts.name: manage_contacts
manage_contacts.description: A contact is a person money is exchanged with (debts and claims: manage_peer_debts). People the owner lends money to or borrows from (one list), and the counterparties: labels under which each appears on bank statements, often with the person's name. Actions: list (contacts with counterparties); search (query, by name); create (name, optional notes); update (contactId; only provided fields change; clear lists notes to empty); delete (contactId; transactions detached); link_counterparty (contactId and label or transactionId, whose label is used; attaches every non-internal transaction it recognises, past and future; a label belongs to one contact); unlink_counterparty (counterpartyId; transactions detached); suggest_counterparties (contactId; labels of unattached transactions containing a word of the name, most frequent first). A transfer between the owner's own accounts is never attached to a contact.

manage_cooking_timers.name: manage_cooking_timers
manage_cooking_timers.description: A cooking timer counts down a recipe step while the owner cooks; being told something later is a proaction (schedule_proaction). Actions: list, start, pause, resume, add, cancel. list returns running, paused and done timers (label, step, remainingSeconds, endsAt). start needs label, recipeId, stepPosition, durationSeconds; pause, resume, cancel need timerId; add needs timerId and seconds (negative removes). A refusal returns error plus the current timers.

manage_envelopes.name: manage_envelopes
manage_envelopes.description: An envelope is the amount budgeted for one category over a period, or for a one-off event; the classification is a category (manage_categories). Before set: status. Budget envelopes: one category for one period, amountCents a positive integer in cents. mode monthly needs year + month (1-12), annual needs year, one_off is an event: name + amountCents, no category or period (spends join it via manage_transactions oneOffEnvelopeId). Actions: list; set (categoryId, amountCents; creates or updates that category's envelope; monthly with year + month and toYear + toMonth together sets every month of that range, all or nothing); update (envelopeId + fields); delete; status (year, month, default current: per envelope spent, committed, planned, consumed, remaining, available; outsideMonthlyBudget lists annual and oneOff ones); rollover (fromYear/fromMonth to year/month; same amounts, or actual spending if useActualSpending; existing targets untouched); split (envelopeId of the mother, children [{envelopeId, amountCents}] among its direct sub-category envelopes; over-allocation is refused). seasonalAmounts (monthly, set/update): [{fromMonth, toMonth, amountCents}], months 1-12; amountCents covers the other months; replaces all seasons, [] removes them.

manage_finance_settings.name: manage_finance_settings
manage_finance_settings.description: The owner's finance parameters, not his figures. Reads or changes the finance settings. Actions: get, update. Treasury: salaryExpectedDay (1-31, last day on shorter months; clearSalaryExpectedDay true forgets it), overdraftLimitCents (0 or more). Safety cushion: targetMonths (1 or more), monthlyNetIncomeCents (0 or more), criticalMonths (0-24, default 2: below it all saving goes to the cushion), cushionSharePercent (0-100, default 60: share of saving going to the cushion above it), rechargeCapCents (0 or more), rechargeTargetMonths (1 or more, indicative). update changes only the given fields, at least one required, all or nothing. Amounts are integer cents. get returns the stored settings only; the cushion state and a late salary are in get_finance_summary.

manage_food_intakes.name: manage_food_intakes
manage_food_intakes.description: An intake is what the owner ate; a meal planned on a day is manage_meals, eaten with create and its mealId. Actions: list, create, update, delete. list needs date (YYYY-MM-DD): {intakes, plannedMeals (not yet eaten)}. create, one of: mealId alone (eats the planned meal, eatenAt defaults to now); else eatenAt (ISO 8601 with offset, required) + label + kcal (0-10000), optional proteinG, carbsG, fatG (grams), quantityGrams; ciqualCode (search_ciqual_foods) + eatenAt + quantityGrams, kcal and macros from Ciqual unless given. update, delete need foodIntakeId; update changes only fields given, nothing recomputed; deleting a meal's intake makes the meal planned again. Returns {success, intake}. Refusal: {error, field?, current?}, nothing changes.

manage_ingredients.name: manage_ingredients
manage_ingredients.description: An ingredient is a food of the owner's catalogue, used by recipes and the list; non-food is manage_products, reference nutrition search_ciqual_foods. Before create: search_ingredients. Actions: create (needs name, category), update and delete (need ingredientId). category: produce, dairy, meat, fish, grain, spice, condiment, frozen, beverage, other. Units: g, kg, ml, l, cl, piece, bunch, can, bottle, pack, sachet, jar. ciqualAlimCode (search_ciqual_foods) supplies macros and micronutrients. pieceWeightGrams: grams of one piece, for recipe nutrition. packagingUnit, with packagingSize and packagingSizeUnit for its content, always together (pack, 500, g). stockState: in_stock (default), low, out. restockQuantity: packagings to buy when out (integer, 0 or more). autoRestock: relists itself. clear (update): optional fields to empty (not name, category, stockState, autoRestock).

manage_investments.name: manage_investments
manage_investments.description: Makes a project an investment, only for a project that yields money; a savings simulation is manage_placements. Actions: get, set, remove; all need projectId. get returns the investment (null if none). set takes the WHOLE investment, replacing the current one, in integer cents: downPaymentCents (required, 0 allowed; loan = price minus it), monthlyRentCents (required, 0 allowed), priceCents (optional), loan (required unless the down payment is the whole price or the project already has a loan source): {annualRateBasisPoints, durationMonths}; resale (optional, null = none): {month YYYY-MM, netAmountCents, targetProjectId?}. remove keeps the project and its funding. A missing value is refused with the list of what is missing, plus current.

manage_loans.name: manage_loans
manage_loans.description: A loan is a bank credit, signed or projected; money owed between people is manage_peer_debts. Actions: list, create, update, delete, timeline, early_repayment. Integer cents, rates basis points, ISO dates. create needs name, principalRemainingCents, monthlyPaymentCents. clear lists fields to empty. type: amortizing_fixed (default); amortizing_variable (needs referenceIndex, marginBasisPoints; optional rateCapBasisPoints, rateFloorBasisPoints); in_fine, bridge (need durationMonths); stepped (needs steps [{fromMonth from 1, monthlyPaymentCents}]); deferred_partial, deferred_total (need deferralMonths > 0). Optional: periodicity (monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual), prepaymentPenaltyMode (legal_cap default, fixed needs prepaymentPenaltyFixedCents, exempt), partialRepaymentEffect (shorten, lower_payment). projected = true: unsigned loan. timeline: horizonMonths. early_repayment: loanId, optional amountCents; returns penaltyCents, realGainCents. An invalid or missing condition is refused with error plus current.

manage_meal_groceries.name: manage_meal_groceries
manage_meal_groceries.description: For a planned meal (manage_meals) only; a thing to buy on its own is add_grocery_item. Before add: preview, then add only what the owner chose. Choose the ingredients of a planned meal that go on the grocery list. preview lists them with toBuy (packagings), stock state (in_stock, low, out), suggested=true when low or out. add puts only ingredientIds (comma-separated, from preview; empty adds nothing) on the list, replacing what the meal put there.

manage_meal_settings.name: manage_meal_settings
manage_meal_settings.description: The default number of people per meal; one meal's guests are manage_meals. Actions: get, update. defaultGuests: people per meal without guests of its own (1 or more, 2 by default). update needs it and rescales the grocery list for upcoming meals following the default.

manage_meals.name: manage_meals
manage_meals.description: A planned meal is a meal, not an event: find it with list and query, no dates. Actions: list, create, update, delete. A meal is a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a slot (lunch = noon, dinner = evening); recipeIds comma-separated. list needs fromDate and toDate, or query (title words, tolerant to case, accents, typos; all agendas, next year when no dates). create needs date and slot, returns groceryPreview (ingredients with stock), to choose from with manage_meal_groceries. guests (1 or more) scales recipes and, on update, the grocery list; unset follows the manage_meal_settings default, useDefaultGuests true restores it. update and delete need mealId.

manage_notifications.name: manage_notifications
manage_notifications.description: A notification is a push sent now to the owner's devices; it schedules nothing. Later is a proaction (schedule_proaction); a question with options is ask_owner, which notifies by itself; in a live chat the reply needs none. Actions: create, list, delete, and mark as read (unknown ones refused, valid listed). create sends a push: type (proaction, approval, reminder, task_due, grocery, finance, message, question), title, optional body, relatedEntityIri, the screen a tap opens (/api/events/{id}, /api/tasks/{id}, /finance/banks, message: /chat?message={id}). question needs interaction {kind: choice, options, multiple, questionId}. list: unreadOnly, limit. Mark as read and delete need notificationId.

manage_operations.name: manage_operations
manage_operations.description: Operations: criteria plus a qualification copied onto matching transactions (one movement: manage_transactions); with a recurrence it is a series, else a categorization rule. Criteria: counterpartyName, labelPattern + matchType contains|starts_with|equals, direction debit|credit, minAmountCents/maxAmountCents (absolute). Recurrence (fixed at creation, all four or none): period, anchorOn ISO, referenceAmountCents (signed, not 0), accountId; plus label. list: recurring filter; series carry monthlyCostCents, yearlyCostCents, nextOccurrenceOn; recurring true adds lastOccurrence (dateGapDays, deviations) and totals (costs, monthlyIncomeCents, activeCount). suggest: series detected in the bank history, writes nothing; minOccurrences (default 3, min 2); each ready to create, plus occurrences. update: provided fields only; clear empties label, a criterion or endsOn. preview (before create): same criteria (operationId when editing), returns total, changeCount. create/update: applyToExisting (default false). apply: operationId, or all. learn: transactionId, categoryId. attach: operationId, transactionId; refused if occurrence taken or account, currency or sign differ. detach: transactionId. delete: operationId. mandatory (bool, cannot be cut) and kind (none, saving, investment, loan, repayment: debit = I pay back, credit = I am paid back) go with categoryId, all or none (a partial set is refused with the current qualification); categoryId alone brings the category's.

manage_peer_debts.name: manage_peer_debts

shares.description: what the agent sent: checked one by one

manage_peer_debts.description: Money between the owner and people he knows, tied to real movements. Créances (people owe the owner) and dettes (the owner owes them); bank loans: manage_loans. Integer cents. list: optional contactId, status, direction. summary: owedToMeCents, iOweCents per contact. set_my_share: transactionId of a spend, myShareCents (owner's part, 0 <= part < amount), shares [{contactId, amountCents}] for the others (omit amountCents to split equally, else sum = amount - part), optional object, notes; null myShareCents removes it. record_debt: transactionId of a received transfer, contactId (sender), amountCents to give back (0 < amount <= transfer), optional object, notes; null amountCents removes it; both refused once repaid. allocate: transactionId, kind; received: income, repayment, new_debt (contactId, amountCents); sent: repayment, new_claim (contactId), other. repayment needs shareId (from list) and amountCents <= its remainder, 0 detaches; one allocation per call; kind null undoes; internal transfers refused. Returns peerKind, allocations, unallocatedCents.

manage_periods.name: manage_periods
manage_periods.description: A period links a context to a stretch of time (a place, a situation, custody, holidays, a trip, a public holiday): it records the fact and Maggie reads it to adapt her answers, reminders and proactions over that stretch. It sits beside the events, not a long event: events are planned inside it and it never conflicts with them. A context during which other things happen and get planned (a trip, holidays, custody, a stay away) is a period; what fills the whole time and makes the owner unavailable (a festival, a seminar, a trade fair) is an event, even over several days. A state of health is not a period. One period per stretch, never one event per day. After create, read the stretch with get_events and say which planned events it affects. Never synced with Google. Fields: name, agenda_id (id or name), schedule given whole: start_date (YYYY-MM-DD) + start_time (HH:MM) + end_date + end_time, or all_day true + start_date + end_date (EXCLUDED), rrule: RFC 5545 without the RRULE: prefix, e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2. list: from, to (YYYY-MM-DD, to included) returns periods meeting those days, repeats unfolded; else every period as stored. create: name, agenda_id, schedule. update: period_id, only given fields (rrule "" stops repeating). delete: period_id, removes the series. Refused: error plus current. Returns what was saved in the period's zone, with startWeekday, endWeekday or lastDayWeekday, and lastDay for days.

manage_placements.name: manage_placements
manage_placements.description: A placement is a savings simulation, not an account (manage_accounts); its figures are a range of the possible, never advice. Actions: list, create, update, delete, simulate. Fields: name; initial (integer cents >= 0, paid on day one); deposit (integer cents >= 0); frequency (monthly, quarterly, yearly: deposit at each period end; once: on day one); annualRate (basis points, 0 to 10000, 600 = 6 %); years (1 to 60). create needs all six, and initial and deposit are not both 0. A placement is read back with final, paid, interest, rent and monthlyDeposit, all integer cents. simulate with placementId returns the saved placement year by year; without it, a what-if from initial, deposit, frequency, annualRate and years. A refusal returns error plus current.

manage_products.name: manage_products
manage_products.description: A product is a non-food item of the owner's catalogue; not a line of the list (add_grocery_item) nor what is left at home (update_stock). Before create: search_products. Actions: list, create, update, delete non-food products (food: manage_ingredients). Units: g, kg, ml, l, cl, piece, bunch, can, bottle, pack, sachet, jar. packagingUnit, with packagingSize and packagingSizeUnit together. stockState: in_stock (default), low, out. restockQuantity: packagings, whole number >= 0; seasonMonths: months 1-12 in season in France, pre-filled on create when the name is known; inSeason returned. clear lists fields to empty: defaultUnit, packagingUnit, packagingSize, packagingSizeUnit, restockQuantity, seasonMonths.

manage_project_funding.name: manage_project_funding

sources.description: a list of {kind, amountCents, account?, placement?, loan?}

manage_project_funding.description: How a project is paid. Before set: options compares the ways. Actions: set, options; both need projectId. set takes sources, the WHOLE list replacing the current one ([] removes all): {kind, amountCents (integer cents > 0), account?, placement?, loan?}. kind savings: account = id of a savings or checking account outside the safety cushion. kind capital: account = id of an investment account; placement = optional simulated placement id. kind loan: creates a projected loan; loan = {annualRateBasisPoints, durationMonths} required, optional manage_loans conditions; omitted loan keeps current conditions. At most one loan source; sources cannot exceed the project's amount. options prices cash, loan and partial, each with totalCostCents, netCostCents, monthlyPaymentCents, durationMonths, availableInMonths. Inputs: yieldBasisPoints (required, 0 allowed), loanRateBasisPoints and loanMonths, downPaymentCents (required without a loan source). A missing value is refused with the list of what is missing, plus current.

manage_projects.name: manage_projects
manage_projects.description: A project is something the owner saves or borrows for, ordered by priority; how it is paid is manage_project_funding, an ordering to compare manage_scenarios. Actions: list (each project with purchaseMonth YYYY-MM, null beyond 36 months, and gatheredCents; top level startMonth, netCapacityCents, isIncomeKnown), preview, create, update, delete, reorder. preview: same fields as create plus scenarioId (a stored scenario id, or auto-rapid, auto-balanced, auto-quality); changes nothing, returns scenario {id, name, editable} or null, dates[] {projectId, name, before, after} (purchase month, null beyond 36 months), nDate {before, after}. create needs name and amountCents (integer cents > 0). currency: 3-letter code, default EUR. Dates ISO. wellbeing: essential = 4, high = 3, medium = 2 (default), comfort = 1. dateMode: none, movable, fixed, deadline; fixed and deadline require targetOn, and targetOn requires one of them. dependsOn: ids of the projects this one waits for, replaces the whole list; no self-dependency or cycle.position: 0 = first priority, a new project goes last; reorder takes ids = EVERY project id in the new order (a partial list is refused). update changes only provided fields; clear empties note, dependsOn or targetOn. A refusal returns error plus current.

manage_recurring_groceries.name: manage_recurring_groceries
manage_recurring_groceries.description: A recurring item comes back on the list at a fixed frequency through generate_grocery_list; a product relisted when it runs out is autoRestock (manage_products, manage_ingredients). Actions: list, create, update, delete recurring items, added to generated lists. frequency: weekly, biweekly, monthly. Needs a productId or a customLabel. clear lists fields to empty: productId, customLabel, quantity, unit; one of the two must remain.

manage_scenarios.name: manage_scenarios
manage_scenarios.description: A scenario orders projects with repayments and savings to compare trajectories; a trajectory question goes to the advisor (delegate). Project scenarios: name, ordered projectIds (first = first priority), early repayments, placementIds, monthlySaving (integer cents a month replacing the measured capacity). repayments: [{loanId, month YYYY-MM, amountCents or null = whole capital, effect duration|payment}]. Actions: list; get (scenarioId; adds curve, events); create (name, projectIds); duplicate (scenarioId, optional name); update (scenarioId + fields; resetMonthlySaving=true restores the measured capacity); delete; make_current (scenarioId; the single current scenario drives the Dashboard and treasury); clear_current; compare (scenarioIds, 2+, first = reference); timeline (optional scenarioId); suggest (like create, draft of kind advisor, never current). Returns id, name, kind (user, auto, advisor), status (draft, saved), current, projects, monthlySaving, nDate (YYYY-MM). auto-* scenarios are read-only: duplicate, then edit. A refusal returns error plus current.

manage_stores.name: manage_stores
manage_stores.description: A store is a shop the owner buys in; products are placed with assign_product_store, aisles with manage_aisles. Actions: list, create, update, delete stores, with visitOrder and a description of what they sell (used to assign products). clear lists fields to empty: description.

manage_transactions.name: manage_transactions
manage_transactions.description: A transaction is one movement on an account; a rule or a recurring series over many movements is an operation (manage_operations). Amounts: signed integer cents (negative = expense); dates ISO. list: filters accountId, categoryId (with sub-categories), direction, fromDate/toDate inclusive, query, transferKind, retrospect keep|avoidable|unrated, mandatory (bool), minAmountCents (absolute value); newest first, limit 30 (max 100), returns total; rejected payments only with transferKind rejected. create: accountId, label, amountCents; bookedAt defaults today; status spent|committed|planned|to_arbitrate. update: transactionId, provided fields only; clear removes categoryId, transferKind, recurringOperation, note, oneOffEnvelope, advanceSource; retrospect keep|avoidable|unrated (refused on income or transfer); note max 2000. categorize: transactionId, categoryId. to_sort: uncategorised lines, limit 50, returns total, totalCents, suggestion. sort: transactionId + categoryId or transferKind internal; refused if already sorted. settle_rejection/unsettle_rejection: transactionId of a rejected payment leg, else refused. delete: transactionId. mandatory (bool, cannot be cut) and kind (none, saving, investment, loan, repayment: debit = I pay back, credit = I am paid back) go with categoryId, all or none (a partial set is refused with the current qualification); categoryId alone brings the category's.

manage_utensils.name: manage_utensils
manage_utensils.description: A utensil is a kitchen tool a recipe step uses. Actions: list, create, rename, delete kitchen utensils (oven, Thermomix...). create and rename need name (255 characters at most); rename and delete need utensilId. Names are unique whatever the case: create returns the existing one. Delete removes it from its recipes.

manage_workouts.name: manage_workouts

exercises.description: the list as the agent sent it, checked by the handler

manage_workouts.description: A workout is a sport session, done or planned; a week of strength sessions is prepared by the coach (delegate), each line from get_next_prescription. Actions: list, create, update, delete. Fields: type (run, walk, bike, swim, strength, climbing, other), title, startedAt (ISO 8601 with offset), durationMinutes, distanceMeters (metres), kcal, avgHeartRate, feeling (very_good, good, hard, very_hard), source (manual default, watch, activity, estimated, planned = still to do), externalId, difficulty (1-10), variant (normal, calibration, soft, deload), exercises: ordered list, always sent WHOLE, replaces the previous one. Exercise: exercise (slug), step, sets, target (per set), targetMin, targetMax, restSeconds, tempo (true = 3 s down, 1 s pause), loadKg, targetRir, cue, feeling (too_easy, right, too_hard), done (list of {reps}, {seconds} or {meters}, plus loadKg); both done only. create needs type, title, startedAt, durationMinutes. update, delete need workoutId; update changes given fields only. list filters type, source, exercise (slug), after, before (on startedAt), limit (max 100). Returns {workouts} or {success, workout}. Refusal (nothing changes): {error, field?, current?}. A planned strength session is refused (current = the week's strength sessions) if the week has 3, it is under 24 h from another, or it is the 3rd with an eccentric exercise or under 48 h from another.

mark_grocery_item_missing.name: mark_grocery_item_missing
mark_grocery_item_missing.description: Marks an unchecked item missing: it moves to the product's fallback store if any, else stays. missing=false moves it back to the store it was missing from. For an item the store does not have: neither bought nor removed.

move_to_fallback.name: move_to_fallback
move_to_fallback.description: Moves every unchecked item of a closed store to its product's fallback store. For a closed store; one missing item is mark_grocery_item_missing.

read_bank_statement.name: read_bank_statement
read_bank_statement.description: Consults the bank before any import: nothing reaches Maggie until import_bank_transactions; what Maggie holds is manage_transactions list. Reads one bank account's movements over a period straight from the bank; nothing is written. accountId: a bank-linked Maggie account; from, to: YYYY-MM-DD (to default today). Filters: search (label or counterparty, ignoring case and accents), direction (credit or debit), minAmountCents (absolute value). Returns status ok, entries[] ({ref, bookedOn, amountCents signed, label, counterparty, inMaggie}), firstDay, lastDay, count, truncated (true when entries[] holds the first 200 or the bank has more pages). ref feeds import_bank_transactions. Refusals: status history_unavailable (period over about 90 days needs a new strong authentication) with the bank's message; status rate_limited (daily ceiling).

read_web_page.name: read_web_page
read_web_page.description: For an address the owner or the screen gave. Reading creates nothing: what is found there is created with its own tool once he agrees. Reads a public web page: returns its `title`, its main readable `text` (bounded) and `structured`, the schema.org JSON-LD objects as published (`Recipe`, `Event`, `Product`, `Article`, `LocalBusiness`…). Only public http(s) pages are read, without JavaScript and without the user\'s login; a page that is private, too big, too slow or refused returns an `error` with the reason. Read-only.

record_proaction_result.name: record_proaction_result
record_proaction_result.description: Records the outcome of a claimed (running) proaction: completed with response (may be empty), or failed with error. A completed run also keeps delivery (interrupt, thread or none), topic_key, the verdict (impact low|medium|high, evidence weak|solid, deadline ISO 8601, changed, value (the value read this time, 120 characters at most)), notice (the sentence of the interruption) and message_link (/chat?message=<id>). Executor only, never offered to the model.

remove_grocery_item.name: remove_grocery_item
remove_grocery_item.description: Removes an item no longer wanted (id from get_grocery_list); a bought item is ticked with check_grocery_item, one the store lacks marked with mark_grocery_item_missing.

reorder_grocery_items.name: reorder_grocery_items
reorder_grocery_items.description: Sets item positions from items, a list of {id, position}. Ids from get_grocery_list; the order of a store's aisles is manage_aisles.

replace_recipe_ingredient.name: replace_recipe_ingredient
replace_recipe_ingredient.description: One ingredient swapped, the rest kept; whole lists are update_recipe. Replace the product of a recipe line; steps using the old ingredient use the new one. ingredientId: current line ingredient; new one is withIngredientId or withCiqualAlimCode; quantity, unit kept when omitted. Step texts change only with rewriteText true; the answer lists textSuggestions ({position, before, after}).

save_bilan_step.name: save_bilan_step
save_bilan_step.description: Evening review state only; a consigne of the review is add_bilan_consigne. Records the evening review state. day: YYYY-MM-DD. step (optional): journee, finance, sante, consignes, demain; omitted keeps the stored step, a bilan prepared before it starts has none. tomorrowTasks, tomorrowSpares (optional): [{taskId, title, reason?}], the tasks Maggie plans for tomorrow and the ones she keeps to swap in; omitted keeps them. answers (optional): {tasks: [{taskId, choice: done|tomorrow|later}], mood, fatigue, note}; instructions (optional): [{id, text, kind: reminder|task|instruction, targetId?}]; omitted keeps stored values of that day. Returns the status, or {error}.

save_place.name: save_place
save_place.description: Before: list_places, a place is changed, not created twice. Creates a place (without id) or changes one (with id, from list_places). name and address required. latitude and longitude (degrees) go together. parkingAddress with parkingLatitude and parkingLongitude (together); empty parkingAddress removes it. isHome=true replaces the home. Omitted fields kept. Refusal changes nothing, answers {error, field}. Returns {success, place}.

save_routine.name: save_routine
save_routine.description: For a habit ticked day after day at a moment of the day; a chore with a date, even a repeating one, is a task (create_task with rrule). Before: list_routines, a habit is changed, not created twice. Creates a routine (without id; title, anchor, recurrence required) or changes one (with id; given fields only). title: 255 characters max. anchor: wake, afterBreakfast, afterLunch, afterDinner, or time (needs anchorTime HH:MM, only this anchor). recurrence: {kind: daily}, {kind: weekdays}, {kind: weekly, weekday: 1 Monday to 7 Sunday} or {kind: monthly, monthDay: 1 to 31}. active=false pauses; remind=true asks a reminder. Refused call changes nothing, answers {error}. Returns {success, routine}.

schedule_proaction.name: schedule_proaction

origin.description: Set by the agent code from the owner message, never by the model.

schedule_proaction.description: For what Maggie herself must do or say at that time; a thing the owner has to do is a task (create_task). A standing rule about when Maggie acts, which keeps coming back, is a planning directive (add_instruction), read by her daily planning; a push sent now is manage_notifications. Before: list_proactions around that time, a run already there is not doubled. Schedules a run of Maggie, or a series of runs with rrule (RFC 5545 without RRULE:, FREQ HOURLY to YEARLY, 500 characters at most; scheduled_at must be its first occurrence, else an error names it): at scheduled_at she receives prompt as instruction. Filed as a five-minute event of the internal Maggie agenda (not synced with Google). scheduled_at: ISO 8601 with time, e.g. 2037-01-15T08:30:00+01:00, Europe/Paris without offset, in the future. prompt: self-contained. summary: optional agenda label. kind: reminder (default — the owner asked to be told at that time; always interrupts) or check (verifies or watches; speaks only when useful, triaged). Returns the proaction (proaction.scheduledAt).

search.name: search
search.description: For the owner's records by words when the tool that owns them cannot find them; memory is memory_search, the Internet web_search. Full-text search across the user's own data in Maggie (events, tasks, recipes, products, grocery lists, notifications), any date. Returns matches with highlights. `types` narrows the search (e.g. events); bank transactions are searched only with types=transactions. Event results carry data.startWeekday and endWeekday (timed event), or startWeekday and lastDayWeekday (whole-day event, whose endDate is EXCLUDED; lastDay is its last day). It does not search the Internet.

search_ciqual_foods.name: search_ciqual_foods
search_ciqual_foods.description: Reference data, not the owner's catalogue (search_ingredients): its code feeds ciqualAlimCode or ciqualCode. Search the Ciqual (ANSES) food database by name. Returns code and kcal, protein, carbs, fat per 100 g.

search_ingredients.name: search_ingredients
search_ingredients.description: Search the user's ingredients by name. Returns id, name and category. The owner's food catalogue; reference foods are search_ciqual_foods.

search_products.name: search_products
search_products.description: Searches products (food and non-food) by name; returns id, name, category and type. The owner's catalogue, not the list (get_grocery_list). Read it before creating a product or an ingredient.

search_recipes.name: search_recipes
search_recipes.description: Search recipes by query (name) or tag; one of the two is required. The owner's recipes; a meal planned on a day is manage_meals list.

set_day_plan.name: set_day_plan
set_day_plan.description: Sets the user's day. Before: get_day_plan, since the list replaces the slots; confirm only what the owner agreed to. taskIds is the whole ordered list of the day's tasks, 5 at most: it replaces the slots, so keeping a task means listing it, and a task listed in place of another sends the other back to the reserve. A task appears once. date is YYYY-MM-DD, today when left out; a future day is allowed. confirm=false writes a proposal (confirmedAt stays null). Returns the day as get_day_plan does.

set_trip.name: set_trip
set_trip.description: Keeps the trip of an event, which drives its departure alert; estimate_trip first when the mode is open. Set the trip to an event: recomputed now, replaces the trip for that leg and occurrence. date (YYYY-MM-DD, Paris): the occurrence's day; required for a repeating event, else optional and must match. mode: drive, transit, walk, bicycle. origin: position (phone position), place:<id> or event:<id>. arriveAt: ISO 8601 Paris time, whole-day event only, refused otherwise. decidedBy: user (origin kept) or maggie (default). leg: outbound (default) or return (event place to home: no origin/arriveAt; departAt ISO 8601 Paris time is never moved; alert stops 30 min after). carAt (drive only): parked (where the phone last saw the car parked, refused if never seen) or origin (at the trip's origin, no walk to it); default: parked from position, origin from home or place:<id>, from event:<id> at that event when reached by car. Returns {success, trip: {id, eventId, event: {summary, startAt, location}, leg, occurrenceStartAt, mode, arriveAt?, origin: {kind, id, label, latitude, longitude}, originDecidedBy, steps: [{kind, minutes, label?}], durationMinutes, departAt, navigationUrl, computedAt, carLatitude?, carLongitude?, carAt?}}, Refused: nothing changes, {error, field}; Google down: {error}.

update_event.name: update_event

reminders.description: minutes before the start, e.g. [60] for "une heure avant"

update_event.description: Update an event by id (master id for a series); only given fields change. Moving a timed event: check_conflicts on the new slot first. Schedule, given whole, never a duration: start_date (YYYY-MM-DD) + start_time (HH:MM) + end_date + end_time, or all_day true + start_date + end_date; end_date is EXCLUDED. An incomplete schedule or an end not after the start changes nothing and returns an error with currentSchedule. clear: fields to empty (description, location, rrule, reminders). agenda_id: name or id; unknown or ambiguous: error listing the agendas. status: tentative or confirmed. reminders: minutes before start; replaces the set. Returns the saved event in its own time zone: allDay; startAt, endAt (timed); startDate, endDate, lastDay (whole-day); status; weekday, startWeekday, endWeekday, lastDayWeekday for each local date.

update_health_day.name: update_health_day
update_health_day.description: The owner's mood, fatigue or a note for a day; body numbers are manage_body_measurements, stable data update_health_profile. Writes a day of the health journal: date (YYYY-MM-DD) and at least one of mood (1-10, 10 best), fatigue (1-10, 10 most tired), note (max 2000 characters; blank removes it). Only arguments given change; a missing day is created, marked as written by Maggie. Returns {success, day} or {error, field, current}.

update_health_profile.name: update_health_profile
update_health_profile.description: Before: get_health_profile. A weighing alone is manage_body_measurements. Changes the health profile: given arguments only, at least one. sex (male, female), birthYear, heightCm (100-250), weightKg (max 500, also recorded as a weighing), activityLevel (sedentary, light, moderate, active, very_active), mode (computed, entered), enteredNeedKcal (1000-5000), stepGoal (500-50000), suggestionWindowStart, suggestionWindowEnd (HH:MM, end after start), sessionMinutes (15, 20, 30), stepSource (health_connect, none), fastingProtocol (14:10, 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, none), fastingWindowStart (HH:MM). Returns {success, profile}, or {error, field}.

update_recipe.name: update_recipe
update_recipe.description: Before: get_recipe, lists replace the whole list; one ingredient swapped is replace_recipe_ingredient. Update a recipe; only given fields change. ingredients, steps and utensils replace the whole list, formatted as in create_recipe; [] empties steps and utensils. tags: comma-separated, empty string empties. clear: [notes] empties the notes. Unknown recipeId is an error.

update_stock.name: update_stock
update_stock.description: Sets what is left of a product at home: state in_stock, low or out; product is an id or a name. An autoRestock product with a restockQuantity is added to the list. Returns what was added or why not, and the next 7 days' meals using it. What is left at home, not the list: a thing to buy is add_grocery_item.

update_task.name: update_task
update_task.description: Updates a task; only given fields change. done with no clear task: its id comes from get_tasks day. done=true completes, false reopens. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. parentId makes it a subtask (one level), position orders siblings. estimatedMinutes 1-1440; firstStep. dueDate: deadline; scheduledDate: planned day. scheduledMoment: morning/afternoon/evening, or time with scheduledTime HH:MM; reminders (time only): minutes before; another moment drops them. timed=true: timer. rrule: new rule from the current day; a moved day moves this occurrence only. clear: fields to empty (description, dueDate, parent, estimatedMinutes, firstStep, scheduledDate, scheduledMoment, rrule).
